Subject: Leadership one‑pager request — Novalabs

Thanks again for today's demo and the operational deep dive. At the leadership level I need a concise summary (one pager) that I can share with our CEO and our procurement lead that covers: top business outcomes, current pain that drives urgency, procurement timeline, critical risk areas and mitigations, and a clear ask for next steps.

High level priorities that surfaced on our side:
- Reduce inference cost for batch scoring by ~40% while keeping P95 latency under 200ms for API calls.
- Data residency: pay attention to where logs/metrics are retained.
- Pilot needs to demonstrate accuracy parity on our sample prompts (we'll share).

Can you put something together by EOD Monday that I can distribute to execs? Procurement contact is procurement@novalabs.com (Carlos copied).

Thanks,
Elena Soto

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@novalabs.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novalabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership one‑pager request — Novalabs

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a 1‑page executive summary and a short procurement path sketch. Quick highlights below (TL;DR for execs):

Pain & impact
- Current batch scoring spend concentrated on GPU instances; estimated monthly bill $86k for peak models. Primary pain: unpredictable token costs + burst latency spikes impacting nightly ETL windows.
- Business impact: revenue-affecting delays for model-driven recommendations and potential SLA misses for top-10 enterprise customers.

Business outcomes & success metrics (pilot)
- Cost: target 35–45% reduction in per‑token cost vs current infra.
- Latency: P95 API < 200ms for peak traffic slices; 95% of batch jobs complete within nightly window.
- Quality: maintain +/- 1% F1 on our labeled prompt set (they will send dataset).

Proposed pilot (scope & timeline)
- Phase 0 (1 week): exchange data samples and finalize success metrics; security questionnaire; sign NDA addendum.
- Phase 1 (6 weeks): deploy on Redwood Dedicated in US-West, run A/B with production traffic shadowing (metrics evaluation every week).
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): operationalize failover policies and handoff to Novalabs infra team.

Procurement path & key dates
- Novalabs procurement kickoff: week of Jun 19 (Carlos) — we expect SOW review + initial comments within 10 business days.
- Target MSA + SOW signed: no later than Aug 1.
- Pilot start target: Aug 7.

Top risks & mitigations
- Data residency / logs: offer configurable retention + option for Private deployment; MSA clause to specify log retention and access controls.
- Performance regression: run parallel A/B tests and gated rollout with automatic fallback to current model.
- Legal terms & IP: prepped standard MSA with limited IP transfer; legal creative required for telemetry.

Immediate asks
- Novalabs: confirm the labeled prompt dataset by Jun 16 and confirm procurement kickoff contact (Carlos).
- Redwood internal: Marissa — lead pilot success plan and run the evaluation script; Ben — prepare pricing/term sheet options for a 6‑8 week pilot; Kimberly — stand by for contract redlines.

Attaching: novalabs-exec-onepager-v1.pdf (one‑pager), procurement-path-sketch.pdf

Happy to hop on a 15‑minute call with your CEO next week to walk through the one‑pager.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Soto <elena@novalabs.com>

Logan — this is very helpful and close to what the execs need. Two quick changes/notes from our side:

1) Pilot duration: can we scope the pilot to 8 weeks total (Phase 1 = 8 weeks) so we can collect both batch and incremental results across our busiest windows? It's important for the CFO to see a month of steady-state numbers.
2) Procurement & billing: procurement@novalabs.com will require an SOW and a purchase order process. Carlos will lead and expects to get the SOW to finance for PO creation once received. Please send invoices to procurement@novalabs.com.
3) Credits/discounts: CFO asked if Redwood would consider a pilot credit against committed spend should we convert to Dedicated capacity. Not a hard ask, but worth flagging now.

Legal will want to review the telemetry/logging language — I'll push to get legal review started this week. I'll confirm the labeled prompt set by Jun 16 as requested.

I'm copying procurement on the thread so we have a single view of the timeline.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Product, Novalabs
